statements.text: All perception, thought and action are accomplished by multitrack processes of interpretation and elaboration over hundreds of milliseconds. Discriminations are distributed in space and time and made only once, with no re-presentation to a central audience. Drafts of narrative fragments are continually revised in many places, and no one draft is the canonical stream of consciousness.

sources.quote: According to the alternative "Multiple Drafts" model, discriminations are distributed in both space and time in the brain.
Drafts of experience can be revised at a great rate, and no one is more correct than another.
